Chain rule: after a pair (A, B), the next pair in the chain is the one whose first item is B. Start at aaa: the pair (aaa, bbb) comes first; its second item is bbb, so the next pair is the one whose first item is bbb: (bbb, ccc). Its second item is ccc, but ccc is the dangling end of the chain.
